description: Generic SS14 — 40 V / 1 A Schottky diode in SMA (DO-214AC). SMD equivalent of 1N5819. The maker-default freewheel diode for boost converters (MT3608, etc), reverse-polarity protection on logic-level rails, and freewheel for low-current relay/motor coils.
name: ss14
watch_out_for: Vf ≈ 0.45-0.55 V at 1 A — significantly lower than a silicon diode but not zero; budget ~0.5 W dissipation at 1 A continuous and provide copper area at the cathode pad for heat. Reverse leakage is higher than silicon (tens of µA), so avoid SS14 on very-low-current circuits where leakage matters. Cathode marked with a band on the body. For >1 A continuous step up to SS24 (2 A) or SS34 (3 A) in the same SMA outline.
